اصطبحا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَحَا (iṣṭabaḥā) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اُصْطُبِحَا (uṣṭubiḥā) /usˤ.tˤu.bi.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبِحَا (iṣṭabiḥā) /isˤ.tˤa.bi.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
